create.name: Integral Yoga Center Barcelona Ribes
create.bio:
Integral Yoga Center Barcelona Ribes is a small Integral Yoga studio in Sant Pere de Ribes, a town in the Garraf hills just inland from Sitges, south-west of Barcelona. It teaches the method of Sri Swami Satchidananda, a disciple of Swami Sivananda, which joins hatha yoga, meditation, selfless service and the study of yoga philosophy under the interfaith motto that truth is one and paths are many. Its director since 2001, Kirana Lee Stover, met Satchidananda in 1982, trained as an Integral Yoga teacher at his Virginia ashram in 1993 and has led 200-hour teacher trainings at the centre; a few teachers she trained share the classes.

The centre has two practice rooms and a garden. Every hatha class follows the Integral Yoga format of opening chants, postures, deep relaxation, breathing and meditation, at levels from beginners to a more demanding second level that adds headstand and kriyas. Thursday evenings bring a raja yoga study group on Patanjali's Yoga Sutras, and the week also includes a meditation session, a sung Hanuman Chalisa and an open sangha hour for self-practice. The house has a long link with kirtan, having hosted chant leaders such as Krishna Das, and it holds devotional concerts and joins local interfaith and community projects.

courses.title: Clases de Integral Yoga Hatha y Raja Yoga (horario otoño 2026)
courses.description: Weekly hatha classes on four days, a Thursday raja yoga study group, and Friday meditation and Tuesday Hanuman Chalisa sessions open to all. Classes are paid singly or with a six- or twelve-class card; the meditation and chanting sessions are by donation.
courses.price: Clase suelta 12 €; bono 6 clases 65 €; bono 12 clases 120 €; meditación / chalisa: la voluntad

courses.title: Clases particulares
courses.description: Private sessions at an agreed time for students who want a practice shaped around them, following the same Integral Yoga elements of postures, relaxation, breathing and meditation.

courses.title: Anahata, el sonido del alma (concierto de música devocional)
courses.description: An evening concert at the centre bringing together Indian classical music and devotional bhakti song, with vocalist Dr. Rajnandini, Rohit Mistry on tabla and Santosh Ghante on harmonium. Places are reserved by WhatsApp.
